name: Traling Stop (when SL used and Not)
summary: This EA is a trailing stop utility that automatically adjusts the stop loss of open positions as price moves in favor. It handles both positions with an existing stop loss and positions without one, applying the trailing step to both buy and sell positions.
summary_zh: 这是一个追踪止损工具EA，会根据价格有利变动自动调整持仓的止损位。它同时处理已有止损和无止损的仓位，对多单和空单都适用追踪止损逻辑。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是追踪止损（Trailing Stop），即当价格朝有利方向移动时，逐步将止损位向开仓价方向移动以锁定利润。入场条件方面，该EA本身不执行任何开仓操作，仅对已有持仓进行管理。出场条件方面，通过不断上移（多单）或下移（空单）止损位来实现条件性出场，当价格回撤触及追踪止损位时平仓。仓位管理方面，该EA不涉及仓位大小设置，仅修改已有仓位的止损和止盈水平。资金管理方面，该EA没有任何资金管理逻辑，不计算风险比例或动态调整仓位。该EA的特殊逻辑是对没有设置止损的仓位，当价格超过开仓价一定步长后首次设置止损，然后再进行追踪止损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of this EA is trailing stop, which gradually moves the stop loss in the favorable direction as price advances to lock in profits. Regarding entry conditions, this EA does not open any positions itself; it only manages existing open positions. For exit conditions, it achieves conditional exits by continuously raising the stop loss for buy positions or lowering it for sell positions, closing the position when price retraces to hit the trailing stop level. In terms of position sizing, this EA does not handle lot size calculation at all; it only modifies the stop loss and take profit of existing positions. For money management, the EA has no money management logic whatsoever, lacking risk ratio calculations or dynamic position sizing. A notable feature is its handling of positions without a stop loss: it first sets an initial stop loss when price moves beyond the open price by the trailing step, then continues trailing from there.

parameters.name: Traling_Step
parameters.description: 追踪止损步长（点数），即止损距离当前价格的距离
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop step in points from current price

pros: 逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和使用，适合初学者
同时处理有无止损的仓位，覆盖了两种常见场景
支持多单和空单两种方向的追踪止损
pros_en: Simple and clear logic, easy to understand and use, suitable for beginners
Handles both positions with and without existing stop loss, covering two common scenarios
Supports trailing stop for both buy and sell positions
cons: 只有一个追踪步长参数，缺乏最小盈利距离和止损级别的区分，灵活性不足
空单止损判断逻辑存在bug：用stopLoss < openPrice判断无止损，但空单的止损本应大于开仓价，此条件永远为真
没有止损修改失败的错误检查和处理，PositionModify返回值未被验证
没有过滤品种，会对所有品种的持仓执行追踪止损而非仅当前图表品种
没有考虑点差和最小止损距离限制，可能导致修改失败
cons_en: Only one trailing step parameter, lacking distinction between minimum profit distance and stop level, insufficient flexibility
Sell position stop loss detection has a bug: using stopLoss < openPrice to detect no SL, but sell position SL should be above open price, making this condition always true
No error checking for failed stop loss modifications; PositionModify return value is not validated
No symbol filtering, applies trailing stop to all symbols' positions instead of only the current chart symbol
Does not consider spread and minimum stop distance limits, which may cause modification failures
improvements: 修复空单无止损判断逻辑，应使用stopLoss == 0或判断止损是否在正确方向来判断无止损情况
添加PositionModify返回值检查和错误处理逻辑，添加品种过滤仅处理当前图表品种的仓位
增加最小盈利距离参数，区分首次设置止损的触发条件和后续追踪步长，添加止损级别参数以支持多级追踪
improvements_en: Fix the sell position no-stop-loss detection logic; should use stopLoss == 0 or check if SL is in the correct direction relative to open price
Add PositionModify return value checking and error handling logic, add symbol filtering to only process positions of the current chart symbol
Add a minimum profit distance parameter, separate the trigger condition for initial SL setting from the trailing step, and add stop level parameter to support multi-level trailing

risk_points: 空单无止损判断逻辑存在bug，导致已有止损的空单会被错误地当作无止损处理，可能将止损移到错误位置
没有错误处理机制，止损修改失败时无法感知，可能导致仓位失去保护
没有品种过滤，可能意外修改其他品种的持仓止损
risk_points_en: Sell position no-SL detection bug causes positions with existing SL to be incorrectly treated as having no SL, potentially moving stop loss to wrong level
No error handling mechanism; failed stop loss modifications go undetected, potentially leaving positions unprotected
No symbol filtering may accidentally modify stop losses of positions on other symbols

summary_en: This EA is a trailing stop utility that automatically adjusts the stop loss of open positions as price moves in favor. It handles both positions with an existing stop loss and positions without one, applying the trailing step to both buy and sell positions.
